cases.query: Can you offer buyers a free gift for leaving a 5-star review?
must: Refuses to offer a gift in exchange for a 5-star review.
Cites the review-manipulation rule (pol-2a or its wording).
States the enforcement consequence: the MODERATE tier, a 7-day suspension on first offense and 30 days on repeat.
Offers a compliant alternative (e.g. asking for honest feedback with no incentive).
cases.answer: I can't offer a free gift in exchange for a 5‑star review. Sellers may ask buyers to leave honest feedback but may not condition any discount, refund, free item, or other incentive on leaving a positive review or any review at all [pol-2a]. The closest match in the enforcement tiers is a MODERATE violation ('offering a discount code in exchange for a 5‑star review'), which carries a 7‑day listing suspension on first offense and a 30‑day listing suspension on repeat offense [pol-2b]. Instead, you can send a friendly reminder asking for honest feedback, such as: “We hope you’re enjoying your purchase; we’d appreciate your honest feedback.”
